blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–NLEX officially secured the No. 1 pick in the 2027 PBA Rookie Draft following Blackwater’s elimination from playoff contention in the season-ending Governors’ Cup. Blackwater’s 101-96 loss to Ginebra on Friday at Ynares Center in Antipolo assured the Road Warriors of selecting first in the proceedings set for Jan. 17, followed by Titan Ultra and Barangay Ginebra. The Road Warriors own the Bossing’s draft rights after acquiring the pick two years ago in a three-team trade that sent Brandon Ganuelas-Rosser to TNT.
